# hush_custom_mcp_application (Data Source)

A custom MCP server, read by name. Its secrets are never returned, so the data source has no attribute for them; `auth` shows which credential is configured.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hush_custom_mcp_application" "internal_tools" {
  name = "internal-tools"
}

# The id applications are created from.
output "internal_tools_app_catalog_id" {
  value = data.hush_custom_mcp_application.internal_tools.app_catalog_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The custom app's name.

### Read-Only

- `app_catalog_id` (String) The id an application is created from: the name prefixed with 'custom-'.
- `auth` (List of Object) The fixed credential the gateway presents to the server, without its secret; empty when there is none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auth))
- `client_id` (String) The client id of the OAuth app registered with the server, or empty when there is none.
- `description` (String) A description of the custom app.
- `display_name` (String) The name the custom app is shown under.
- `headers` (Map of String) Extra HTTP headers the gateway sends with every request to the server.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `oauth_relay` (Boolean) Whether the server's OAuth flow goes through Hush's relay.
- `scopes` (List of String) The OAuth scopes to request from the server.
- `tool` (List of Object) The tools the server offers, as declared or as the gateway detected them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tool))
- `url` (List of Object) The addresses the server is reachable at. When there are several, an application picks one by `url_label`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--url))
